title: Round 2 — the same real-stack scenarios on 7a324350 (main merged)

notes.text: The merge commit changes no MCP logic: every claim still holds and every round-1 finding reproduces unchanged. The 190-call detach puts a number on triage stage-2 point 3 (lookup() re-acquires the owner on every 100 ms poll).

title: Round 2 — merge-resolution audit and gates at 7a324350
subtitle: 7a324350 = e3ecba66 + main a765229c (#12848 Hosted Shell turns, #12942 FG6e, #12918). Hand-resolved parts read with git show --remerge-diff.
lines: ## Hand-resolved parts: 9 files, +76 / -133 (PR file set unchanged, plus hosted-workspace-broker.test.ts)
++ toolProfile accepts files | shell | mcp; one profile per Session, so Shell and MCP never meet in one turn
++ declarations = (shell ? Shell tools : file tools) + MCP tools, awaited each round
++ prepare(runtimeCallId, digest, shellInputDigest, promptId): both sides keep their arguments
++ MCP calls use only their control payload; Shell input, digest and timeout stay on the Shell branch
++ the worker keeps both the remote Shell publishers and the MCP runtime
== MCP profile still skips the per-turn broker.release() -> F1 root cause unchanged
## Gates
++ GitHub CI @7a324350: 22 pass, incl. Hosted fault gates on MySQL 8.4 (HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT 5/5, 96.8 s) and MariaDB
++ local -Phosted-harness-mysql verify checkstyle: unit 182/182, HostedHarnessMySqlIT 2/2, 0 Checkstyle violations
!! local HostedWorkspaceToolTurnIT 3/5 in 439 s at load 50-100: FG6B writers:renew 409, six-Workspace driver 130 s timeout
++ rerun of those two alone at load 31-54: 2/2 in 203.7 s (HOSTED_STORE_FAILURES_OK, 100 MiB Shell OK) -> load, not code
-- #12894 (a7c0a391, open) still adds V19 -> the V19 clash with this PR is unchanged
## Mutation on the merged tree (6 cli test files, 112 tests)
++ R1   Shell profile advertises file tools only                  KILLED (15)
++ R2   prepare drops promptId (triage stage-2 point 7)           KILLED (5); survived on the a390b5d5 tree
++ R3   prepare drops the Shell input digest                      KILLED (1)
++ M13  configurations owned by two Runtime Sessions              KILLED (1); survived in round 1
!! M7   -32601 from a tools-only server -> empty complete list    SURVIVES
!! M11  prompt route hasPendingOperations() guard (the F3 409)    SURVIVES

notes.text: The resolution is faithful to both sides and the merge added coverage (R2, M13). Nothing in it touches F1-F7, so the round-1 findings stand as they were.
